## Services & Engineering Pillars

1. **Web & App Development**: Custom full-stack web platforms, native Android apps (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose), Windows desktop software (.NET 10/WPF, Electron), and backend API architecture.
2. **Product Design & Design Systems**: High-craft UI/UX design, interactive motion prototypes, Liquid Glass and dark glassmorphism systems.
3. **Automation Systems & AI Workflows**: Claude context-window tooling, autonomous agents, RAG pipelines, AI customer support, and business process automation.

### Marquee
- **URL**: https://neosparkx.com/products/marquee
- **Platform**: Windows 10 & 11 (x64) (desktop) | **Version**: 0.5.20 | **Status**: Live
- **Tagline**: Fluid, all-in-one screen capture, recording, measurement & clipboard studio
- **Description**: An ultra-fast, physics-driven desktop companion for Windows 10 & 11 that replaces 5+ separate utility apps. Unifies precision screenshot capture, 60fps screen recording, PixelSnap-style layout measurement, color picker loupe with swatch history, clipboard manager, and offline Windows Media OCR into a cohesive iOS 26 Liquid Glass experience.
- **Tech Stack**: .NET 10, WPF, C#, Win32 API, Windows Media OCR, Liquid Glass UI
- **AI / Claude Integration**: Extract on-screen terminal outputs, mockups, and layout coordinates via native OCR and clipboard studio directly into Claude prompt sessions.


- **Download**: https://pub-69ed05fa22a045f290cb8b358ee464fe.r2.dev/Marquee-Setup-0.5.20.exe


- **Key Features**:
  - **All-in-One Floating HUD**: Summoned via Shift+S or PrtScn with ~28% soft desktop dimming, dynamic cut-out area selection, dimension badges, and one-tap tool access.
  - **Precision Screenshot Studio**: Area crosshair, Win32 DWM window border detection, multi-monitor display capture, 5s delay timer, and interactive thumbnail HUD.
  - **60–120 FPS High-Framerate Recording**: Fluid recording up to 4K UHD with system audio, microphone compositing, cursor click indicators, and a floating frosted webcam bubble.
  - **PixelSnap-Style Screen Measurement**: Automatically finds UI boundaries, buttons, cards, and text blocks beneath the cursor with real-time distance guides.
  - **11×11 Color Picker & Swatch Studio**: Magnifier loupe with live HEX, RGB, HSL, and SwiftUI format switching, plus an interactive 150×104 squircle swatch history.
  - **Native Windows Media OCR**: Extracts text from images, videos, and locked UI elements directly to the clipboard using offline, privacy-safe Windows OCR.
  - **Liquid Glass Clipboard History**: Floating bottom capsule HUD with category filter tabs, substring search, favorite pins, and password manager privacy filters.
  - **Integrated Annotation & Video Editors**: Redact with Gaussian blur or pixelate, add arrows and step badges, or trim recordings with direct MP4 and GIF export.

Features an Apple iOS 26-inspired real-time SDF Liquid Glass optical engine with curved-bevel refraction and RGB chromatic dispersion, 16 interactive desktop widgets across 6 categories, instant disk-cached Weather, dual-channel auto-updates, and ~24 MB private RAM usage with 0% idle CPU.

- **AI / Claude Integration**: Domain logic verified across 6 safe Rust crates with 6,400 parity checks, delivering real-time system telemetry and persistent desktop notes.

  - **16 Widgets Across 6 Categories**: Interactive Calendar, Clock, System Monitor, Sticky Notes, Reminders, and Weather widgets with magnetic grid snapping and 4 responsive sizes.
  - **4 Bespoke Liquid Glass Clocks**: Includes Analog I (Minimal Lens), Analog II (Sculpted Bezel), Analog III (Squircle Contour), and a split-flap Flip Clock with metallic side hinges.
  - **Instant Disk-Cached Weather**: Loads forecasts in under 5 ms from persistent cache with 1-click IP Auto-Detect, global city search, hourly strips, 7-day bars, and unit toggles.
  - **Pure Rust & Direct2D Performance**: Consumes ~24 MB RAM and 0.0% idle CPU inside a standalone 2.3 MB Setup installer with zero .NET, Electron, or WebView2 runtime overhead.
  - **Dual-Channel Auto-Updater**: Supports native silent Microsoft Store MSIX updates and SHA-256 verified direct updates from GitHub Releases and NeoSparkX.

## Engineering Works & Case Studies (22 Projects)

### Marquee Screen Studio
- **URL**: https://neosparkx.com/works/marquee
- **Category**: Desktop App | **Platform**: Windows Desktop Application (Windows 10 & 11, x64) | **Role**: Systems Architect & Native Desktop Engineer
- **Summary**: The fluid, all-in-one screen capture, recording, measurement & clipboard studio engineered natively for Windows 10 & 11 with iOS 26 Liquid Glass UI.
- **Overview**: Marquee is the ultimate all-in-one desktop companion for Windows 10 & 11 that unifies 5+ separate utility programs into a single, ultra-fast, physics-driven application. Designed around the iOS 26 Liquid Glass philosophy, Marquee delivers 100% native Windows feature parity while preserving the refined physical feel of modern Apple human interface guidelines—featuring optical acrylic washes, specular rim illumination, spring physics motion, and unified squircle geometry. The application consolidates precision screenshot capture, 60–120 FPS high-framerate screen recording, PixelSnap-style layout measurement, 11×11 color picker loupe with swatch history, clipboard manager, and native Windows Media OCR into a single lightweight tray companion.
- **Tech Stack**: .NET 10, C#, WPF (XAML), Win32 API (user32, gdi32, dwmapi), Windows Media OCR, Liquid Glass UI, Inno Setup

### uWidgets (Rust Edition)
- **URL**: https://neosparkx.com/works/uwidgets
- **Category**: Desktop App | **Platform**: Windows Desktop Application (Windows 10 & 11, x64) | **Role**: Systems Architect & Native Rust Desktop Engineer
- **Summary**: Ultra-lightweight, real-time Liquid Glass desktop widgets for Windows 10 & 11 — rebuilt from the ground up in pure Rust, Win32, Direct2D, and DirectComposition.
- **Overview**: uWidgets (Rust Edition) is a ground-up native Win32 + Direct2D + DirectComposition desktop widget platform built in pure Rust. Engineered to eliminate the ~140 MB RAM footprint and 60+ MB runtime bloat of managed desktop widget apps, uWidgets compiles down to a compact native Windows binary (~24 MB private RAM, 0.0% idle CPU, 2.3 MB Setup installer) while delivering an Apple iOS 26-inspired real-time SDF Liquid Glass optical engine, 16 interactive desktop widgets across 6 categories, instant disk-cached Weather, and dual-channel automatic updates.
- **Tech Stack**: Rust (Edition 2024), Win32 API, Direct2D, DirectWrite, DirectComposition, SDF Liquid Glass Shader, MSIX / WinRT StoreContext

### Quick-Pill Dynamic Island
- **URL**: https://neosparkx.com/works/quick-pill
- **Category**: Desktop App | **Platform**: Windows 10 & 11 (x64) · Linux x64 (X11 & Wayland) | **Role**: Lead Product Designer, Systems Architect & Creative Engineer
- **Summary**: A fluid, non-intrusive Dynamic Island companion rebuilt in Tauri v2 & Rust for Windows 10/11 and Linux with per-app WASAPI audio mixing, drop shelf, and native notifications.
- **Overview**: Quick-Pill is an open-source desktop application that brings the fluidity of Apple's Dynamic Island natively to Windows 10 & 11. Designed around the core philosophy of zero-distraction productivity, Quick-Pill rests unobtrusively as a minimal 170px semicircular capsule at the top edge of your monitor. Upon cursor hover or click, it expands with fluid spring physics into an interactive control center featuring 11 modular tabs—including a native Windows UWP notification engine with executable icon extraction, real-time media controls with marquee titles, active camera/microphone privacy dots, instant hardware utilization readouts, Things 3-style tasks, and focus timers with depleting SVG border strokes.
- **Tech Stack**: Tauri v2, Rust, React 19, Framer Motion 12, Vite 5, Win32 / WinRT / WASAPI, Linux X11 & Wayland (GTK3)

### MarkItDown
- **URL**: https://neosparkx.com/works/markitdown
- **Category**: Web App | **Platform**: Web Application & Windows Desktop (x64) | **Role**: Lead Developer, UI/UX Designer, Full Stack Developer
- **Summary**: A privacy-first, serverless client-side document converter that instantly transforms local files into clean, LLM-ready Markdown text without external cloud uploads.
- **Overview**: MarkItDown is a privacy-first web application designed to convert document formats like PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, CSV, HTML, XML, JSON, and EPUB into clean, structured Markdown. Built to satisfy the data input needs of modern Large Language Models (LLMs), it focuses on utility, data privacy, and a bold Neo-Brutalist design. All core parsing algorithms execute 100% locally in the user's browser, bypassing the need to upload files to external servers. An optional integration with Supabase provides persistent history tracking for premium accounts, while a seamless postMessage bridge securely connects the web app with the Companion Extension.
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase, React Router v7, Mammoth.js, PDF.js (pdfjs-dist), SheetJS (XLSX), JSZip, GSAP

### MarkItDown Companion (Chrome Extension)
- **URL**: https://neosparkx.com/works/markitdown-companion
- **Category**: Automation | **Platform**: Chrome Extension (Developer Tool / Companion Utility) | **Role**: Lead Browser Extension Developer, Content Script Engineer, Security Architect
- **Summary**: A browser companion to sync markdown files, track real-time AI token usage, and locally export conversations from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Grok.
- **Overview**: The MarkItDown Companion is a browser extension (Manifest V3) designed to bridge the user's live AI web conversations with their local Markdown editing workspace. It injects a floating control overlay and status badges directly into the interfaces of Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Grok. Users can track their session token usage in real time, extract fully formatted chat logs as clean Markdown or high-quality PDFs locally, and queue document payloads. Through a secure cross-origin bridge, the extension syncs queued items directly into the user's active MarkItDown web app workspace without intermediate database storage.
- **Tech Stack**: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Chrome Extension APIs (Manifest V3), Tiktoken, Offscreen Documents, chrome.storage, CSS3

- **Overview**: Prevention is a privacy-first, security-hardened Android application designed to help Muslims overcome pornography addiction. - **Overview**: Jilani Home is a state-of-the-art, peer-to-peer real estate and property listings marketplace designed to bypass traditional brokers. It connects owners directly with tenants and buyers looking for high-quality residential apartments, workspaces, and event spaces. Unlike conventional real estate listing platforms that charge heavy brokerage commissions, Jilani Home operates on a micro-transaction points system. Users buy point packages through local payment gateways (bKash, Nagad, Rocket) and spend small point amounts to unlock private property listings, giving them 2-month access to verified physical addresses (house, road, block, landmark) and direct contact details of hosts (phone, WhatsApp). The front-facing landing page features a cutting-edge "Liquid Glass" visual style with heavy background blurs and soft rounded bento panels, offering a highly exclusive and premium experience, complemented by two dedicated client-side dashboard panels for standard members and site administrators.

### Ron Bot Mobile
- **URL**: https://neosparkx.com/works/ron-bot
- **Category**: Mobile App | **Platform**: Hardware (ESP32), Desktop (Windows), Mobile (Android) | **Role**: Lead Developer, Hardware Prototyper, Firmware Engineer, Full Stack Developer, Mobile App Developer
- **Summary**: An interactive, desktop companion robot with dual-transport synchronization, localized sensory interfaces, and real-time cloud management.
- **Overview**: Ron Bot (internal codename Ron) is a consumer hardware product featuring an physical desktop companion robot. The product ecosystem communicates directly via localized peer-to-peer protocols and a cloud-assisted realtime broadcast system, completely bypassing intermediary server relays. The physical robot runs a robust, low-latency firmware written in C++ on an ESP32 microcontroller, integrating multiple local sensors, auditory buzzer engines, memory storage, and full WiFi networking capabilities. It interacts with users via a potentiometer-driven 7-page display system (Expressive RoboEyes, Weather Dashboard, Retro Flip-Clock, Pomodoro Timer, Tasks Screen, System Settings, and WiFi QR Pairing) and capacitive touch. The software layer consists of two client companion apps: a native Flutter Windows Desktop Application acting as the cockpit for the bot, and a portrait-locked Flutter Android Mobile Application with a redesigned Material 3 navigation shell. Both apps implement a Smart Connection Router with dual-transport sync (switching between local WebSockets and Supabase Realtime channels) and open-ended chatbot sessions via OpenRouter AI. Additionally, a Next.js 16 storefront provides pre-ordering, waitlisting, and transactional administration, running completely serverless with a Supabase cloud database backend and localized Bangladeshi wallet payment integrations (RupantorPay).
- **Tech Stack**: C++, ESP32, Flutter, Dart, Next.js 16, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, Phoenix Channels, Room DB, Kotlin

- **URL**: https://neosparkx.com/works/tyvik-web
- **Category**: Web App | **Platform**: Web App | **Role**: Lead Developer, Full Stack Developer, UI/UX Designer
- **Summary**: A high-performance, dark-themed pre-order storefront and administrative dashboard for the Ron Bot companion.
- **Overview**: The Ron Bot Web App (Next.js Hub) is the digital storefront, user pre-order platform, and administrative command center for the Ron Bot ecosystem. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, and Supabase, it provides customers with an interactive, motion-rich experience to learn about, compare, and pre-order different Ron Bot models (Classic, Keychain, Ultra). Behind the scenes, the web application runs completely serverless, leveraging a PostgreSQL database on Supabase and integrating localized Bangladeshi payment wallets (RupantorPay) via an Android SMS APK relay. Authenticated users can manage their orders and register their physical devices in a personalized dashboard, while administrators can track waitlists, send batch templated updates using React Email and Resend, configure inventory, and view analytics charts built with Recharts.
